title: Columbia’s publication output by field, 2021–2024
description: Aligned yearly trend lines for a fixed set of Columbia’s ten largest OpenAlex fields. Compare each field with its own 2021 baseline, or switch to a common zero-based count scale. The right columns show the endpoint counts and percent change.

issues.problem: The source note says “defined child institutions” without identifying which institutions are included or how they were chosen.
issues.fix: List the included OpenAlex institution IDs or link to a methodology note that defines the Columbia institution scope.

issues.problem: In the selected screenshot, the tooltip shows Medicine’s exact annual counts but covers part of the title and the 2021 column label.
issues.fix: Position the tooltip beside or below the active row, keeping the title and year labels visible.

issues.problem: The mode-switch test confirms that Counts changes the rendering, but not that all rows use the same zero-based domain. Keyboard focus for annual details is advertised but not covered by the reported tests.
issues.fix: Add a check for the shared zero-based Counts domain and verify that keyboard focus on a year point reveals its exact value.

reviews.summary: The aligned small multiples make all ten fields easy to compare on the shared index scale without letting Medicine’s larger volume flatten the other trends. Computer Science (+22.2%) and Earth and Planetary Sciences (−31.6%) stand out, and the subtitle distinguishes the university-wide 2024 rebound from output still being 1.6% below 2021. Exact counts and clear selection feedback make the view usable as is.
